questions.question: Your CV includes data collection, preparation, analysis, and medical-records work. Can you walk me through the most technically complex dataset you worked with, including how you collected, cleaned, validated, and reported the data?
In your healthcare data roles, how did you verify the accuracy and completeness of patient records or HCC information before assigning codes or submitting information?

This role requires building ETL pipelines. Describe how you would design a pipeline to ingest healthcare claim or patient-record data, validate it, transform it, and make it available for reporting while protecting sensitive information.
What experience do you have with SQL or relational databases? Please describe any tables, queries, reports, or data-quality checks you have created or maintained.
How would you identify and resolve duplicate, missing, inconsistent, or invalid values in a dataset containing medical codes, billing information, and patient records?

The position requires Scala, Spark, Java, and Spring-based REST APIs. What exposure or training have you had with programming languages, data-processing tools, APIs, or software development, and how have you applied it?
Give an example of a time you had to interpret detailed coding rules or regulations, such as ICD, CPT, HCPCS, billing guidance, or HIPAA requirements. How did you ensure your work was compliant?

Describe a situation where you worked with multiple stakeholders—such as physicians, billers, insurance payers, or nontechnical staff—to resolve a data, coding, or reimbursement issue. What was your role and outcome?
How would you approach learning a new technical platform such as AWS or Spark when you need to contribute to a data-engineering project quickly?

This remote SaaS environment requires collaboration and ownership. Can you share an example of managing competing deadlines, maintaining accurate records, and communicating progress or issues to others?
